description: A footer with a band of service highlights, a newsletter signup, a link directory, and legal links.
overview: A tinted band lists four services, each with an icon, title, description, and Learn more link, in two columns or four at `md:`. Below it, a newsletter row places a heading beside a form built from `InputGroup`, `InputGroupInput`, `InputGroupAddon`, and `InputGroupButton`; it stacks on small screens and becomes a row at `md:`. A `nav` directory follows in two columns, or four at `md:`, and a bottom row holds the copyright, legal links, and a region link.
usage: Edit `services` (icon, `title`, `description`), `sections` (directory titles and links), and `legal` at the top of the file. Links use hash anchors from the `slug` helper; replace it with your routes. The email, validation flag, and subscribed state are held in `React.useState`. On submit, the form checks the address against the `EMAIL` pattern and shows a confirmation if it matches; send the address to your mailing list provider at that point.
notes: The email input has `aria-label="Email address"` and sets `aria-invalid` when validation fails; the form uses `noValidate` so the custom check runs instead of the browser's. The submit button has `aria-label="Subscribe"`, and its arrow flips with `rtl:rotate-180`. The confirmation uses `role="status"`. The directory is a `nav` labeled Directory inside a `footer` landmark.
